segment_captions.caption: C looks around the room, focusing on a desk with various items on it.
C opens a cabinet door revealing various items inside, including a yellow object and blue containers.
C walks towards a mirror, then turns around and walks back towards the cabinet.
C walks towards a mirror, adjusting their hair.
C removes a pink jacket from a hanger and holds it up, examining it closely in front of a mirror.
C adjusts a pink cloth over their head, pulling it up with both hands.
C adjusts a pink hooded garment over their head, then turns towards a wardrobe filled with clothes and toys, reaching inside with both hands.
C reaches into a closet filled with stuffed animals and toys, pulling out a pink plush toy.
